name: DeepSeek
description: DeepSeek's own platform credits new accounts with 5M tokens, no card up front.
overview: DeepSeek's first-party platform gives every new account 5,000,000 free tokens on signup — roughly $8 of use — with no credit card until the grant is spent. The grant covers all models, including DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and V4 Pro, through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.deepseek.com/v1 with a 1M-token context and automatic prefix caching. Caching makes repeated prompts roughly 90% cheaper, and off-peak pricing is half the peak rate. There is no perpetual free model: once the grant is used, calls bill against a prepaid balance.

privacy.label: Inputs may be used to improve the service

free_access: 5M free tokens on signup, valid about 30 days
No card required until the grant is exhausted
OpenAI-compatible, 1M context on V4 Flash and V4 Pro
Automatic prefix caching, off-peak rates at half price
notes: The signup grant is not printed on the public pricing page; it appears in the console after registration. No fixed public rate limits — concurrency is throttled dynamically, with HTTP 429 under load.
